# Urbicon UI

> Svelte 5 component library with built-in i18n, OKLCH design tokens, and AI-native developer experience.

## Overview

Urbicon UI is a Svelte 5 + Tailwind CSS 4 component library designed for LLM-assisted development. It uses a custom zero-dependency `tv()` variant engine for styling, a three-layer OKLCH token system for automatic dark mode, and provides production-ready primitives and patterns.

## Quick Start

Packages are published on the public npm registry — no registry configuration needed, just install:

```bash
bun add @urbicon-ui/blocks
# or: npm install @urbicon-ui/blocks
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Input, Card } from '@urbicon-ui/blocks';
</script>

<Card variant="elevated" padding="md">
  <Input label="Name" placeholder="Enter name" />
  <Button intent="primary" variant="filled">Submit</Button>
</Card>
```

## Documentation

- [Full API Reference](llms-full.txt): Complete component props, variants, tokens, and patterns
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Token system, Mint interactions, i18n, docs-gen pipeline
- [API Conventions](docs/COMPONENT-API-CONVENTIONS.md): Props patterns, callbacks, styling rules
- [Component Structure](docs/ComponentStructureStandard.md): File layout, index.ts pattern

## Components

- **Layout**: Card, Modal, Dialog, Popover, Tooltip, Separator, Accordion
- **Actions**: Button, ButtonGroup, Toolbar, Dropdown, Combobox
- **Forms**: Input, Checkbox, Toggle
- **Feedback**: Badge, Spinner, Pagination, Alert, Toast, Skeleton
- **Navigation**: Tab, Breadcrumb
- **Display**: Avatar
- **Help / Guidance**: Guide, GuidePanel, GuideHint, GuideMarker, GuideMention, GuideBeacon (bidirectional in-app help: opt-in spotlight tour, contextual hints, non-modal help panel, UI↔guide links)

## Key Patterns

All components share: `intent`, `size`, `variant`, `unstyled`, `slotClasses`, `mint`, `class` props.
Import from `@urbicon-ui/blocks`. Use semantic tokens (`bg-surface-base`, not `bg-white`). Use `focus-visible:` for focus styles.
